description: AstraSight is a student team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are interested in NASA satellite data, Earth observation, AI/ML, data science, and software development. Our team aims to build an innovative solution using MODIS and VIIRS hotspot data. We are looking for teammates skilled or interested in AI/ML, Python, GIS, web development, UI/UX, data visualization, space science, and communication.
